name: allocation-webapp

dependencies.name: allocation-api
dependencies.description: Calls the allocation API for engagements, requests, allocations, and the team roster.

description: Single-page React app for Engagement Managers, Resource Managers, and Team Members: create and manage engagements, submit and track allocation requests, review and approve requests against team capacity, manage the team roster, and view allocations. Holds no business logic and no secrets — everything goes through allocation-api.
